title: One More Take
blurb: You are the stunt double on an action set that never wraps. The effects crew fires your rigs on their own clocks while extras pour in from every side; all you choose is where to stand. Bank the reels the fallen drop, take the writers' pages, and hold the floor until the lead falls and someone calls CUT.
